answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can earn, and let peers slash that bond when they catch fabricated work. Spinning up a thousand sybils then means funding a thousand bonds, so the cost rises like an incoming tide instead of a trickle. A single fraud caught burns the whole deposit, and that identity dies like a comet flaring out. The old fable that fresh identities are free stops holding once every voice must put real capital at risk.
